brief: RenderBrief(subject='A single host in a navy tracksuit jacket and gray t-shirt standing full-figure in a narrow power stance, palms turned outward at chest height, inside a cramped public-access studio; behind him a hand-painted cosmic backdrop of black velvet airbrushed with purple-magenta nebula swirls, scattered white stars and one ringed planet; around his body a crudely composited yellow energy aura — a hot, slightly green-tinted chroma-key glow layered over his silhouette with visible misregistration, doubled edges, and a spill halo bleeding off his shoulders and arms', motion='The host holds nearly still, breathing visibly, arms trembling with slow effort as his palms press outward; the yellow aura does the moving — it flickers, blooms and collapses along his outline as the imperfect key grabs and releases his edges, spilling over his sleeves and dropping out around his hair; chroma bleed shimmers horizontally off high-contrast edges; a tracking-noise band crawls up the frame once, bending the image into flagged horizontal streaks; the backdrop layer slips a few scanlines out of alignment, doubling the painted stars', camera='Locked-off single studio camera, 4:3 full shot framed head-to-toe with the host centered against the painted cosmos, flat high-key video lighting with hot falloff, auto-iris slowly pumping as the aura blooms, video-depth-of-field softness throughout, 480i interlaced scanline structure visible on motion', style="Late-1990s S-VHS public-access look: color-under chroma bleed where saturated yellow smears sideways, luma/chroma misalignment, soft analog resolution with smeared highlights, head-switching noise bar at the bottom of frame, occasional white dropout streaks, timestamp-white balance slightly green, palette of hot yellow aura against black-purple painted nebula, everything bearing a faint interlaced comb on the host's moving arms", audio_direction='Low-level tape hiss and 60Hz mains hum under everything; a cheap preset synth pad drone from a home keyboard swelling slowly in a warbling tape-flutter pitch wobble; muffled small-studio room reverb; faint cassette-era new-age flute loop buried low; brief audio dropout crackle synced to the tracking-noise band', negatives='no modern VFX, no particle systems, no smooth digital compositing, no clean anime glow, no lens flares, no motion blur trails, no morphing or dissolves between aura states, no extra figures, no text artifacts or lower-thirds', identity_lock='navy tracksuit jacket and gray t-shirt, hand-in-hand palm-out stance, yellow-green aura hue, black velvet backdrop with purple nebula and ringed planet, 4:3 frame, persistent chroma bleed and tracking noise')
